items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Chick Webb died, and the Ink Spots and Ella took the band over; she was the leader of the band. So they asked me to come and play with the band.

ctx.x: Yeah, Chick Webb died, and the Ink Spots and Ella took the band over; she was the leader of the band. So they asked me to come and play with the band. Tommy Pulford, I think he was inducted into the Army as I remember, or he might have been ill -- I forget exactly. But I imagine he was inducted. So I went to Baltimore with the band, and we played the tribute for Chick.
This was soon after you got back.
